findings.summary: The public replay hard-coded a 96% decision-confidence value that was not present in the evidence contract.
findings.resolution: Numeric confidence was removed. The UI now derives only qualitative per-line confidence counts from selected observations.

findings.summary: Alternative selection was reset across stages; public what-if math lacked compatible-unit normalization and treated missing price as zero in the displayed total.
findings.resolution: Selections now persist, pound/ounce math normalizes through a shared base unit, and incomplete price evidence produces a nullable/incomplete estimate.

findings.summary: Native evidence types are stricter than the wire schema and native surplus handling is less general than backend normalization.
findings.resolution: The frozen demo contract is compatible, but broader nullable/mixed-unit native ingestion remains a documented follow-up.

findings.summary: A live request has bounded individual Browser and Sandbox operations but no single end-to-end deadline across sequential candidate research.
findings.resolution: Candidate count, per-operation timeouts, rate limiting, and default-off operator admission bound the current demo; an aggregate deadline remains a production-hardening follow-up.

findings.summary: Remote DNS cannot be pinned through the current Browser SDK and the in-memory limiter uses forwarded address metadata.
findings.resolution: Admission and final-URL checks, exact owned-host allowlisting, operator authentication, and default-off live mode reduce current exposure; production deployment still needs trusted-proxy and DNS controls.

findings.summary: The reviewer suggested explicitly closing the Solari Sandbox client after killing the sandbox.
findings.resolution: The installed @solarisdk/sandbox 0.1.2 SandboxClient exposes no close or dispose method. The created Sandbox is killed in finally, which is the available lifecycle primitive.
